tracks.title: 求其填
tracks.subject: A 48-year-old clerk in a Sheung Wan shipping office fills in the morning paper's Sudoku in ball-pen before the pantry kettle boils, and the whole floor thinks he is a genius, though he just writes any numbers because nobody ever checks; when the tea lady spots three sevens in one row he confesses to everyone, and nobody believes him: so clever, they say, and modest too.
